Notes:
10.1 The sale of goods (Alumina and Aluminium) is made against either advances received from customers or letter of credit. The advance received from
customer is adjusted on sale. The average credit period for sale of wind power is 30 days from the date of metering which is considered as collection period.
10.2 Customers that individually represent more than 5% of the total trade receivable as on 31.03.2021:
Customers % of trade Customer Category
receivables
a. DUBAI ALUMINIUM PJSC 44% Alumina
b. APSPDCL 19% Wind Power
c. RDPPC, DEVIKOT, RAJASTHAN 12% Wind Power
10.3 The company has used a practical approach for computing expected credit loss allowance for trade receivables based on a case to case basis. Since there is
no credit period for sale of alumina and aluminium and the sale is either made against an advance or backed by letter of credit (LC) given by customers, no
credit loss is expected against such receivables. For sale of wind power, although there is no credit arrangement, the Company estimates credit losses based
on credit loss experience and forward looking information.
